title: Project
description: Frontmatter schema for project.md. Authoritative on conflict with SPEC.md.

formatVersion.description: Version of the file format. Optional for reading (absent means 1), always written by the tool. Readers must refuse versions they do not know.

id.description: UUID4. Stable identifier of the project. The folder name is not the id but the slug of the name.

name.description: Unique across all projects (the folder name is a slug of it).

referencePath.description: Optional. Absolute path of the associated working directory (e.g. a repo) from which tasks were created.

referenceHost.description: Optional. Machine name on which referencePath applies.
